_status: REALISTIC-MAGNITUDE Tier 2.1 test -- first application of the validated 5-HT1A time-dependent autoreceptor mechanism to a real, already-audited drug config, now that the mechanism's SHAPE was confirmed reproducible on real hardware (see PRECISION_GAP_CLOSURE_PLAN.md 2.1, 2026-08-06 validation note). Does NOT replace test_buspirone.json -- that file stays as the clean, already-passed baseline without this mechanism, for comparison.
_reference: Postsynaptic ec50/hill/max_k_gain identical to test_buspirone.json (unchanged, already real-world-anchored). autoreceptor_ec50=0.0005 keeps the same ~30x-more-sensitive anchor sourced from F13714/F15599 5-HT1A ligand data (see PRECISION_GAP_CLOSURE_PLAN.md 2.1). max_autoreceptor_suppression=0.7 and the tau values remain ILLUSTRATIVE PLACEHOLDERS, not literature-sourced for buspirone specifically -- real autoreceptor_tau_desense_ms should be on the order of DAYS-TO-WEEKS for a genuine SSRI/buspirone-like delayed-onset story (clinical onset ~2-4 weeks), not the ~20s compressed timescale used here, which exists purely for practical sim_time_ms/wall-clock runtime on this hardware. Treat this config as demonstrating that the mechanism composes correctly with a real, already-validated drug's existing parameters -- not as a calibrated claim about buspirone's actual autoreceptor kinetics.
